narrative: Two blotted sheets on the orchard bench under the apple boughs, the same stone on the corner, the inkhorn in the knot-hole. A hand is flat on the wood and not on the page. No face. The same sheet, the stone shifted an inch so the light falls on the second speech, and no new pen-stroke anywhere on it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read what was already there, and put the stone back.

entities.name: the orchard scene
entities.context: Shown on draft in The sheet he will not touch
